description: The receipts behind the free report card: the most recent 100 calls by one X account, each with its post id and URL, capture time, attribution basis, pool, the three prices its grade is made of (at the call, 30 min before, 1 h after), the grade (early / momentum / neither) or why there is none, the token's outcome, and any cross-chain records. An unknown handle returns a paid EMPTY tape rather than a 404, so you are never charged for a lookup that then errors. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base.
name: robinx_caller_calls
title: One caller's receipts tape
